scripts.build: npm run build -w @dreamwalk/contracts && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/game-core && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/api && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dreamwalk/contracts && npm run build -w @dreamwalk/game-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests docs infra *.json *.mjs *.md
